usageNote: 后面跟从句要用虚拟语气哦！比如 'he suggested that she go'，不是goes！超级常见的坑！

examples.en: He suggested that we take a different route to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 他建议我们走另一条路来避开堵车。

examples.en: He suggested that the meeting be postponed until next week.
examples.zh: 他提议把会议推迟到下周。
